reason: The Drive audit supplies per-record classification values, reading evidence and difficulty, but this lean variant omits the registrar-level statistics, CrossConcept definition objects, handoff block and per-record nested classification. The prepared audit is an additive normalization of the SAME 22 audited records; no audited unit, PT, TPL, CrossConcept, Condition, difficulty value, excerpt or verdict is changed. Both the raw audit bytes and this disclosure are SHA-bound in the request.
addedFields: statistics: computed only from this audit's own 22 records and their audited CrossConcept tags
boundAtomicCrossConcepts: 14 labels/definitions copied verbatim from the current ACTIVE canonical shards and 29 courier-authored definitions disclosed in the definitions evidence
handOffToCourier: mirrors the audited manifest READY_FOR_COURIER_REGISTRATION handoff
records[].auditVerdict: 'APPROVED' mapped from the package-level ALL_APPROVED_CANONICAL_STANDARDIZED verdict with zero holds and zero template inflation
records[].classification: assembled from the same record's audited standardCourse/PT/TPL/CrossConcept/Condition values
preservedFields: records[].questionId, standardCourse, standardUnitKey, standardUnit, subUnitKey, subUnit
